title: Consultant Vitreoretina Surgeon (Medical & Surgical)
description: Looking for a skilled Vitreoretinal Surgeon to lead our retina department in Pune. Hospital equipped with Constellation Vision System and Zeiss Lumera 700.
requirements: MS / DNB / DO in Ophthalmology
Long-term Fellowship in Vitreoretinal Surgery (FVRS)
Registered with Maharashtra Medical Council (MMC)
Expertise in Retinal Angiography, OCT interpretation & Retinal Lasers

Excellent patient communication skills in Marathi / Hindi / English
